'''Leeni''' was a wind spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. She was known for making Ewoks laugh until they couldn't breathe, but did not do so maliciously, only because she liked the sound. "Leeni" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Leeni|the Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Ewoks THV">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Leeni was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
